date_policy: No lower publication-date limit; the frozen cutoff is the only publication-date limit.
language_policy: English publications only. Non-English records remain in the retrieval denominator and are excluded as E_LANGUAGE_NON_ENGLISH.
objective: Rebuild, from bibliographic discovery through materialized features and HGB OOF predictions, publication-time paper-innovation and potential-impact features without preset K/Q/P/M/D/F counts.

count_symbols.M: candidate model dimensions from canonical indicator families

count_rule: K, Q, P, M, D and F are outputs. No numeric quota, domain quota, or model-performance-based admission is allowed.

providers.OpenAlex: discovery, recall validation, formal retrieval and citation chaining

h2_required_for: all included and uncertain literature records
a DOI-hash deterministic 10 percent sample of concordant exclusions
all domain and dimension merge/split decisions
reviewers.independence_rule: AI, H1 and H2 outputs must be separately versioned review artifacts. A reviewer may not inspect a primary review before submitting its own blind review. Local Qwen outputs are prohibited.

formal_search_frame_gates: all active terms have a final coded disposition
each retained domain and query has directly source-verified English evidence
at least one hidden validation seed is independently supplied
all indexable English development and hidden seeds are recalled or have provider-level reasons
all active query families pass PRESS
zero-hit and redundant families are archived with reasons
all physical requests map to one logical query
formal_completion_gates: all selected deterministic discovery batches are retrieved
all retrieved records have a final disposition
all disagreements and H2 audits are complete
each final indicator has English full-text formula or operational-definition evidence
each final indicator passes all hard gates
each retained predictive dimension has at least one final indicator and two independently verified research groups
three consecutive fully reviewed dual-zero novelty rounds after the formal frame
all frozen inputs and outputs have hashes

literature_exclusion_reasons.E_LANGUAGE_NON_ENGLISH: Non-English title, abstract, or required full text
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_PAPER_LEVEL_INNOVATION_OR_POTENTIA: Does not study article-level innovation or potential scholarly impact
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_FUTURE_OUTCOME_ONLY: Only post-publication outcomes; no T0 characteristic
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_ARTICLE_LEVEL: Unit is not an individual scientific paper
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_INDICATOR_PREDICTOR_VALIDATION: No indicator, predictor, determinant, definition, or validation evidence
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_DUPLICATE: Duplicate DOI, OpenAlex ID, or normalized title-year identity
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_INSUFFICIENT_METADATA: Title and abstract insufficient for a decision

v4_independence: v3 code may be used as an implementation template only. No v3 database, recovered result, term assignment, screening decision, dimension mapping, indicator definition, or feature membership is imported as v4 evidence or decision.
